text: Observer intervention: a drought for 10 days (experiment).
Observer intervention: a test fire (experiment).
Fire broke out in the granary at Highmoor (a test fire started by the observer).
The alarm sounded in Highmoor: the granary is burning. It was noticed after 22 min.
Brightwater agreed to sell 40 flour to Highmoor for 80 pennies.
Millbrook agreed to sell 400 grain to Highmoor for 400 pennies.
The fire in the granary at Highmoor destroyed the building after 2 h. 18 people fought it with 55 buckets. Lost: 1479 grain and 112 flour; saved: 48 flour. Condition 0%.
Highmoor planned the repair of the granary (0% sound): 3 stages.
Highmoor began rationing: 6.6 days of food for 150 people.
Nimue Starwhisper delivered 25 fish from Saltmere to Highmoor.

Tamsin Ashdown delivered 40 stone from Saltmere to Highmoor.
Clear debris finished on the granary at Highmoor.

Saltmere agreed to sell 30 timber to Highmoor for 120 pennies.
